- settings.get [read] Read the current value of settings rows (ids as ompdesk_app_list shows after "settings."); all rows when ids is omitted. Secrets are never shown.
- usage.read [read] Provider usage and quota windows of the signed-in accounts (what the Usage view shows): each window under its own label with percent used and reset time, and the account's saved resets. refresh asks the providers now. device reads another computer's accounts.
- models.list [read] The model role assignments, then the models of the providers that have a signed-in account (each provider's first 40). provider (id), query (words of provider/id) or all: true list whole catalogs, also of the providers without an account (an aggregator's runs to hundreds). device lists another computer's.
- models.set [change] Switch this session's model.
- models.set_role [change] Assign a model to a model role (default, slow, smol, plan, task, ...); omit modelId to clear the role. device sets it in another computer's omp.
- omp_settings.get [read] Read stock omp settings (the ones omp itself lists, e.g. retry.fallbackChains, retry.fallbackOn, compaction.thresholdTokens): paths = exact paths, query = words from a path, label or description. device reads another computer's omp. Credentials and the approval, security, memory and computer-use settings are never shown.
- omp_settings.set [change] Write one stock omp setting by its exact path (find it with omp_settings.get query). value must fit the setting's type (true/false, number, one of its options, a list, or an object for a record such as retry.fallbackChains). device writes another computer's omp. One step back with app.undo. Credentials and the approval, security, memory and computer-use settings are refused.
- ui.panel [change] Open a side panel view (terminal, diff, preview, files), open a session view as a sheet (jobs = background tasks, plan = the plan document, logs, tree = the session tree, work = the work tree), or close the panel.
- ui.settings_open [change] Open Settings at a section (for the user to look at or to finish a step only they may do).
- sessions.saved [read] Saved sessions on the computer this session runs on (a paired host's own when it runs there): title, folder, last change, path.
- sessions.search [read] Search the text of saved sessions.
- sessions.rename [change] Rename a saved session.
- sessions.delete [sensitive, always a card] Delete a saved session file for good.
- sessions.dump_bundle [change] Save a diagnostic bundle as a zip file and return its path: stock's /dump archive of an open session plus OMPdesk's own diagnostics text. Anonymized by default (message contents redacted); pass anonymized:false only when the person asked for the raw transcript. Writes to path, else the Downloads folder. Needs the session open in a tab; defaults to this session.
- ui.open_system_privacy [change] Open a macOS Privacy & Security pane in System Settings (Accessibility, Screen Recording, ...). It only opens the pane: the person toggles the switch, you cannot. macOS only.
- sidebar.projects [read] The projects listed in the sidebar of the computer this session runs on (a paired host's own when it runs there): folder path, name, and whether the folder is gone; for this computer also its pin and its own name. Use the paths with the other sidebar.* actions.
- sidebar.add_project [change] List a folder as a project in the sidebar of the computer this session runs on (the 'Add new project' / open-folder path; a folder removed before comes back). path is absolute. A linked worktree lists its main checkout.
- sidebar.remove_project [change] Remove projects from the sidebar of the computer this session runs on, as the project menu's Delete does without its 'also delete saved sessions' box ticked. No folder and no session is touched; opening the folder again in OMPdesk lists it again. path or paths must be listed by sidebar.projects: any other path is reported and left alone.
- sidebar.pin_project [change] Pin or unpin a project in this computer's sidebar (the project menu's Pin / Unpin; pinned projects stay on top). path must be listed by sidebar.projects.
- sidebar.order_projects [change] Set the order of projects in this computer's sidebar (what dragging a project does): paths top first, each listed by sidebar.projects. Pinned projects stay above the rest; projects not named keep their place after these.
- sidebar.rename_project [change] Give a project its own name in this computer's sidebar (the project menu's Rename; the folder keeps its name). An empty name clears it. path must be listed by sidebar.projects.
- sidebar.pin_session [change] Pin or unpin a saved session in this computer's sidebar (the session menu's Pin / Unpin). sessionPath from sessions.saved.
- sidebar.archive_sessions [change] Archive or restore saved sessions in this computer's sidebar (the session menu's Archive / Restore: they leave the lists until restored; no file is touched). sessionPaths from sessions.saved.
- updates.status [read] The state of OMPdesk's own update (idle, available, downloaded, ...). host: true reads the paired host this session runs on instead of this computer.
- updates.check [sensitive, card unless the user lets agents manage] Check for a new OMPdesk version now (contacts the release server). host: true asks the paired host this session runs on to check its own.
- updates.download [sensitive, card unless the user lets agents manage] Download the OMPdesk update that updates.status says is available, on this computer (what the Download button does). It installs nothing: updates.apply does, and always asks.
- updates.apply [sensitive, always a card] Install the downloaded OMPdesk update and restart the app (every running turn ends). host: true asks the paired host this session runs on to install and restart its own; it refuses while work runs there.
- disk.status [read] How much disk OMPdesk uses on this computer (worktrees, sessions, logs, stats, app data, session scratch files, the Bun and npm caches) and what the last disk cleanup freed.
- disk.clean [change] Run disk care now on this computer and wait for it: drops build output and dependencies from worktrees idle 3+ days (the project makes them again) and saves then removes worktrees idle 14+ days (restorable from the Work tree view). Nothing the user could lose is deleted.
- app.quit [sensitive, always a card] Quit OMPdesk (every running turn ends).
- accounts.github_status [read] Whether GitHub CLI is signed in and as which login.
- accounts.github_sign_in [sensitive, always a card] Start GitHub sign-in. Only starts the existing sign-in flow (a browser page or a code the person completes); it never reads or stores a credential.
- accounts.provider_sign_in [sensitive, always a card] Start sign-in for a model provider. Only starts the existing sign-in flow (a browser page or a code the person completes); it never reads or stores a credential.
- mobile_web.status [read] Whether the phone page is on and its state (the link is not shown).
- mobile_web.set_enabled [sensitive, always a card for some arguments] Turn the phone page on or off (it exposes this computer's sessions to the person's tailnet).
- extensions.install_plugin [sensitive, always a card] Install a plugin from a marketplace the person already added (it runs code in every session).
- memory.purge [sensitive, always a card] Erase the user's memory for good: every page, handoff and recorded session.
- memory.delete_page [sensitive, always a card] Delete one memory page (the Memory page's Restore can bring it back).
- memory.sweep [sensitive, always a card] Run the memory retention sweep for one project (evicts pages the aging rules let go).
- app.undo [change] Undo the last change you made with ompdesk_app, when it had a previous value.
- agent_power.set [sensitive, always a card] Change what agents may do: OMPdesk control tools, full control, managing or approving for other sessions, tool approval mode, memory, engineering mode or computer use. Booleans take on; tools.approvalMode takes mode. Refused: These switches bound the agent's own power. Only the person changes them, in Settings, unless they give agents full control of OMPdesk.
- cards.answer [never] Answer an [OMPdesk] confirmation card or a tool approval. Refused: A card exists to ask the person. ompdesk_session_answer refuses it too.
- credentials.read [never] Read an API key, token, password, proxy credential or the sign-in state of an account. Refused: Secrets never reach an agent. Use accounts.*_status for who is signed in.
- extensions.install_mcp [sensitive, always a card] Add an MCP server (stdio: it starts a program; http/sse: it reaches a service). The user sees the exact command or url first. No env or headers: secrets are never set by an agent.
- extensions.mcp_servers [read] List the MCP servers this session's omp knows: connected or not, tool count, whether it needs a sign-in, and why one is off (turned off, found only in another tool's config, …).
- extensions.mcp_sign_in [sensitive, always a card] Start the sign-in of an MCP server that needs one (OAuth: a browser page the person completes). Once it succeeds the server connects in every open session, no restart. Only starts the existing sign-in flow (a browser page or a code the person completes); it never reads or stores a credential.
- extensions.mcp_use [sensitive, always a card] Use an MCP server that only another tool's user config declares (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, …; extensions.mcp_servers says 'found in <tool>'): copies that one server's definition into omp's user mcp.json. The tool's other servers, skills and rules stay unused.
- remote.list_tailnet [read] List the computers on the person's tailnet as this one sees them (node id, name, login, whether OMPdesk shares it and lets this computer in, and whether this computer already uses it).
- remote.connect [sensitive, always a card] Connect this computer to another computer of the tailnet that shares OMPdesk (nodeId from remote.list_tailnet), so sessions can run there.
- remote.block [sensitive, card unless the user lets agents manage] Keep a device that uses this computer out for good (deviceId from remote.devices): its Tailscale node is blocked and it is forgotten. Unblock with remote.unblock.
- remote.unblock [sensitive, always a card] Let a blocked device (a computer or a phone) connect again while its Tailscale account is allowed, by its block id or name.
- remote.set_allowed_users [sensitive, always a card] Set the Tailscale accounts allowed to use this computer, from other computers and from the phone page alike (logins; this computer's own stays allowed when the list is empty).
- remote.devices [read] List this computer's device name, the paired computers it connects to (hosts) and the devices that use it (peers), with ids and online state.
- remote.rename_this_computer [change] Change this computer's device name; every paired computer and device sees it at once.
- remote.rename_host [change] Rename a paired computer this one connects to (deviceId from remote.devices): it changes its own device name. It must be online.
- remote.rename_device [change] Rename a device that uses this computer (deviceId from remote.devices): it is asked to rename itself, so it must be connected.
- mobile_web.rename_device [change] Rename a phone or tablet that uses the phone page, by its current name or id.
- autopilot.status [read] Read an Autopilot run you started (state, cycle, branch): ompdesk_autopilot status.
- autopilot.start [change] Start an Autopilot run: ompdesk_autopilot start, with its own confirmation card (commit, push or release) and its folder rules. ship defaults to the user's stored level; device runs it on a paired device (default the device your session runs on).
- autopilot.stop [change] End an Autopilot run after the cycle in flight, or with now: true stop it at once (the turn is aborted and the run paused): ompdesk_autopilot stop.

- settings.rotation [sensitive, card unless the user lets agents manage] Set "Account rotation". One of: quota, even.
- settings.localEngines [change] Set "Detect local inference engines". true or false.
- settings.steeringMode [change] Set "Steering mode". One of: all, one-at-a-time.
- settings.followUpMode [change] Set "Follow-up mode". One of: all, one-at-a-time.
- settings.interruptMode [change] Set "Interrupt mode". One of: immediate, wait.
- settings.compaction.enabled [change] Set "Auto compaction". true or false.
- settings.tui.renderMermaid [change] Set "Render Mermaid". true or false.
- settings.defaultThinkingLevel [change] Set "Thinking level". One of: auto, off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max.
- settings.retry.modelFallback [change] Set "Use fallback models". true or false.
- settings.retry.maxRetries [change] Set "Max retries".

- settings.goal.enabled [change] Set "Goal mode". true or false.
- settings.ttsr.enabled [change] Set "Rule injection (TTSR)". true or false.

- ui.panel [change] Open a side panel view (terminal, diff, preview, files), open a session view as a sheet (jobs = background tasks, plan = the plan document, logs, tree = the session tree, work = the work tree), or close the panel.

- sessions.saved [read] Saved sessions on the computer this session runs on (a paired host's own when it runs there): title, folder, last change, path.
- sessions.search [read] Search the text of saved sessions.
- sessions.rename [change] Rename a saved session.
- sessions.delete [sensitive, always a card] Delete a saved session file for good.
- sessions.dump_bundle [change] Save a diagnostic bundle as a zip file and return its path: stock's /dump archive of an open session plus OMPdesk's own diagnostics text. Anonymized by default (message contents redacted); pass anonymized:false only when the person asked for the raw transcript. Writes to path, else the Downloads folder. Needs the session open in a tab; defaults to this session.
- ui.open_system_privacy [change] Open a macOS Privacy & Security pane in System Settings (Accessibility, Screen Recording, ...). It only opens the pane: the person toggles the switch, you cannot. macOS only.
- sidebar.projects [read] The projects listed in the sidebar of the computer this session runs on (a paired host's own when it runs there): folder path, name, and whether the folder is gone; for this computer also its pin and its own name. Use the paths with the other sidebar.* actions.
- sidebar.add_project [change] List a folder as a project in the sidebar of the computer this session runs on (the 'Add new project' / open-folder path; a folder removed before comes back). path is absolute. A linked worktree lists its main checkout.
- sidebar.remove_project [change] Remove projects from the sidebar of the computer this session runs on, as the project menu's Delete does without its 'also delete saved sessions' box ticked. No folder and no session is touched; opening the folder again in OMPdesk lists it again. path or paths must be listed by sidebar.projects: any other path is reported and left alone.
- sidebar.pin_project [change] Pin or unpin a project in this computer's sidebar (the project menu's Pin / Unpin; pinned projects stay on top). path must be listed by sidebar.projects.
- sidebar.order_projects [change] Set the order of projects in this computer's sidebar (what dragging a project does): paths top first, each listed by sidebar.projects. Pinned projects stay above the rest; projects not named keep their place after these.
- sidebar.rename_project [change] Give a project its own name in this computer's sidebar (the project menu's Rename; the folder keeps its name). An empty name clears it. path must be listed by sidebar.projects.
- sidebar.pin_session [change] Pin or unpin a saved session in this computer's sidebar (the session menu's Pin / Unpin). sessionPath from sessions.saved.
- sidebar.archive_sessions [change] Archive or restore saved sessions in this computer's sidebar (the session menu's Archive / Restore: they leave the lists until restored; no file is touched). sessionPaths from sessions.saved.
- updates.status [read] The state of OMPdesk's own update (idle, available, downloaded, ...). host: true reads the paired host this session runs on instead of this computer.
- updates.check [sensitive, card unless the user lets agents manage] Check for a new OMPdesk version now (contacts the release server). host: true asks the paired host this session runs on to check its own.
- updates.download [sensitive, card unless the user lets agents manage] Download the OMPdesk update that updates.status says is available, on this computer (what the Download button does). It installs nothing: updates.apply does, and always asks.
- updates.apply [sensitive, always a card] Install the downloaded OMPdesk update and restart the app (every running turn ends). host: true asks the paired host this session runs on to install and restart its own; it refuses while work runs there.
- disk.status [read] How much disk OMPdesk uses on this computer (worktrees, sessions, logs, stats, app data, session scratch files, the Bun and npm caches) and what the last disk cleanup freed.
- disk.clean [change] Run disk care now on this computer and wait for it: drops build output and dependencies from worktrees idle 3+ days (the project makes them again) and saves then removes worktrees idle 14+ days (restorable from the Work tree view). Nothing the user could lose is deleted.
- app.quit [sensitive, always a card] Quit OMPdesk (every running turn ends).
- accounts.github_status [read] Whether GitHub CLI is signed in and as which login.
- accounts.github_sign_in [sensitive, always a card] Start GitHub sign-in. Only starts the existing sign-in flow (a browser page or a code the person completes); it never reads or stores a credential.
- accounts.provider_sign_in [sensitive, always a card] Start sign-in for a model provider. Only starts the existing sign-in flow (a browser page or a code the person completes); it never reads or stores a credential.
- mobile_web.status [read] Whether the phone page is on and its state (the link is not shown).
- mobile_web.set_enabled [sensitive, always a card for some arguments] Turn the phone page on or off (it exposes this computer's sessions to the person's tailnet).
- extensions.install_plugin [sensitive, always a card] Install a plugin from a marketplace the person already added (it runs code in every session).
- memory.purge [sensitive, always a card] Erase the user's memory for good: every page, handoff and recorded session.
- memory.delete_page [sensitive, always a card] Delete one memory page (the Memory page's Restore can bring it back).
- memory.sweep [sensitive, always a card] Run the memory retention sweep for one project (evicts pages the aging rules let go).
- app.undo [change] Undo the last change you made with ompdesk_app, when it had a previous value.
- agent_power.set [sensitive, always a card] Change what agents may do: OMPdesk control tools, full control, managing or approving for other sessions, tool approval mode, memory, engineering mode or computer use. Booleans take on; tools.approvalMode takes mode. Refused: These switches bound the agent's own power. Only the person changes them, in Settings, unless they give agents full control of OMPdesk.
- cards.answer [never] Answer an [OMPdesk] confirmation card or a tool approval. Refused: A card exists to ask the person. ompdesk_session_answer refuses it too.
- credentials.read [never] Read an API key, token, password, proxy credential or the sign-in state of an account. Refused: Secrets never reach an agent. Use accounts.*_status for who is signed in.
- extensions.install_mcp [sensitive, always a card] Add an MCP server (stdio: it starts a program; http/sse: it reaches a service). The user sees the exact command or url first. No env or headers: secrets are never set by an agent.
- extensions.mcp_servers [read] List the MCP servers this session's omp knows: connected or not, tool count, whether it needs a sign-in, and why one is off (turned off, found only in another tool's config, …).
- extensions.mcp_sign_in [sensitive, always a card] Start the sign-in of an MCP server that needs one (OAuth: a browser page the person completes). Once it succeeds the server connects in every open session, no restart. Only starts the existing sign-in flow (a browser page or a code the person completes); it never reads or stores a credential.
- extensions.mcp_use [sensitive, always a card] Use an MCP server that only another tool's user config declares (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, …; extensions.mcp_servers says 'found in <tool>'): copies that one server's definition into omp's user mcp.json. The tool's other servers, skills and rules stay unused.
- remote.list_tailnet [read] List the computers on the person's tailnet as this one sees them (node id, name, login, whether OMPdesk shares it and lets this computer in, and whether this computer already uses it).
- remote.connect [sensitive, always a card] Connect this computer to another computer of the tailnet that shares OMPdesk (nodeId from remote.list_tailnet), so sessions can run there.
- remote.block [sensitive, card unless the user lets agents manage] Keep a device that uses this computer out for good (deviceId from remote.devices): its Tailscale node is blocked and it is forgotten. Unblock with remote.unblock.
- remote.unblock [sensitive, always a card] Let a blocked device (a computer or a phone) connect again while its Tailscale account is allowed, by its block id or name.
- remote.set_allowed_users [sensitive, always a card] Set the Tailscale accounts allowed to use this computer, from other computers and from the phone page alike (logins; this computer's own stays allowed when the list is empty).
- remote.devices [read] List this computer's device name, the paired computers it connects to (hosts) and the devices that use it (peers), with ids and online state.
- remote.rename_this_computer [change] Change this computer's device name; every paired computer and device sees it at once.
- remote.rename_host [change] Rename a paired computer this one connects to (deviceId from remote.devices): it changes its own device name. It must be online.
- remote.rename_device [change] Rename a device that uses this computer (deviceId from remote.devices): it is asked to rename itself, so it must be connected.
- mobile_web.rename_device [change] Rename a phone or tablet that uses the phone page, by its current name or id.

- autopilot.stop [change] End an Autopilot run after the cycle in flight, or with now: true stop it at once (the turn is aborted and the run paused): ompdesk_autopilot stop.

- settings.get [read] Read the current value of settings rows (ids as ompdesk_app_list shows after "settings."); all rows when ids is omitted. Secrets are never shown.
- omp_settings.get [read] Read stock omp settings (the ones omp itself lists, e.g. retry.fallbackChains, retry.fallbackOn, compaction.thresholdTokens): paths = exact paths, query = words from a path, label or description. device reads another computer's omp. Credentials and the approval, security, memory and computer-use settings are never shown.
- omp_settings.set [change] Write one stock omp setting by its exact path (find it with omp_settings.get query). value must fit the setting's type (true/false, number, one of its options, a list, or an object for a record such as retry.fallbackChains). device writes another computer's omp. One step back with app.undo. Credentials and the approval, security, memory and computer-use settings are refused.
